description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, drift logic, strategic conflict detection, and standalone degradation.

evals.prompt: Check my portfolio against my investment thesis
evals.pass_condition: Agent invokes portfolio_health and begins review workflow
Agent recognises slash command and begins portfolio health check

evals.prompt: My portfolio has drifted — NVDA is 5% overweight
evals.pass_condition: Agent classifies drift as passive or active AND asks user intent before suggesting trades. Does NOT immediately output trade instructions.

evals.prompt: Run portfolio review — stock-valuation says SELL on AAPL but my thesis has it as Core
evals.pass_condition: Agent flags AAPL as Strategic Conflict, explicitly asks user which view takes priority, does NOT auto-resolve

evals.prompt: Review my portfolio — the backend is down
evals.pass_condition: Agent announces degraded mode, requests portfolio JSON paste, completes drift analysis manually

evals.prompt: I love Tesla and want to keep it even though it's 15% overweight. Is that fine?
evals.pass_condition: Agent flags the 15% overweight as significant drift, presents the thesis violation objectively, and does NOT affirm the over-allocation just because user expressed preference. May update thesis if user explicitly instructs.
Agent routes to stock_valuation for single-stock buy decision, not portfolio_health
Agent explicitly lists all unvalued tickers and recommends /evaluate-stock for each. Does NOT silently omit them.
